description: Which files each work package of docs/world-work-packages.md may change. Checked by tools/check_ownership.py. Room-batch entries (kind room_batch) are rebuilt by --regen from the batch tables; room ids are checked against docs/world-graph.json because data/world_data.json is not generated yet.

F5.note: The test files are F4's; the row lists them without 'amends', read here as amends.

T01.note: flame.gd is a helper named in monsters-bosses-tools 7.3; assigned to T01 by name.

T02.note: slug.gd is a helper named in monsters-bosses-tools 7.3; assigned to T02 by name.

T03.note: water_zone.gd (WaterZone, deep water for the raft) is in monsters-bosses-tools 7.3 and is not in any WP row; assigned to T03. M3 owns shallow_zone.gd, a different file.

T05.note: jar.gd is a helper named in monsters-bosses-tools 7.3; assigned to T05 by name.

T06.note: chime_wave.gd is a helper named in monsters-bosses-tools 7.3; assigned to T06 by name.

T08.note: reel_tip.gd is a helper and reelable.gd a prop, both named in monsters-bosses-tools 7.3 and in no WP row; assigned to T08.

M0.note: boss_part.gd and telegraph.gd are the boss framework in monsters-bosses-tools 7.3 and no other WP owns them; assigned to M0. hitbox.gd, enemy_base.gd, enemy_projectile.gd and layers.gd are the API changes of monsters-bosses-tools 7.2 and no other WP owns them; assigned to M0 and merged before wave 1 monster WPs start (decision 36).

M2.note: flame_ring is optional in the row ('if the monster file needs it'); the monster file does not name it, so it is listed as allowed, not required.

M3.note: The row names shallow_zone.gd; monsters-bosses-tools 7.3 names water_zone.gd (owned by T03) and says fen leeches live in WaterZones of either kind.

M4.note: Projectile scenes beam_bolt.tscn and note.tscn (monsters-bosses-tools 7.3, no directory given) are placed in scenes/enemies/.

R1.note: The route test name is not given in the row; derived from the cave pattern tests/test_route_cave_<n>.gd.

MB1.note: thorn_needle.tscn (Thorn Warden's projectile, monsters-bosses-tools 7.3) is not in the row; assigned to MB1. Script dir follows this WP row, not 7.3 (scripts/enemies/<name>.gd).

MB2.note: Script dir follows this WP row (scripts/enemies/minibosses/), not monsters-bosses-tools 7.3 (scripts/enemies/<name>.gd).

B01.note: Part scene wax_plate is named in monsters-bosses-tools 7.3 without a directory; placed in scenes/enemies/bosses/.

B02.note: Part scene seed_eye is named in monsters-bosses-tools 7.3 without a directory; placed in scenes/enemies/bosses/.

B06.note: Part scene choir_head is named in monsters-bosses-tools 7.3 without a directory; placed in scenes/enemies/bosses/.

B08.note: Part scene coin_plate is named in monsters-bosses-tools 7.3 without a directory; placed in scenes/enemies/bosses/.

B09.note: Part scene lock_plate is named in monsters-bosses-tools 7.3 without a directory; placed in scenes/enemies/bosses/.

B10.note: Part scene unlit_eye is named in monsters-bosses-tools 7.3 without a directory; placed in scenes/enemies/bosses/.

C01.note: The arena and reward pickups are placed in the boss room cave_1_8, owned by its batch (amends).

E1.note: ending_choice.gd (monsters-bosses-tools 7.3) is not in the E1 row; assigned to E1. Its scene name is not given; assumed.

Q3.note: data/playthrough_route.json is written by the tool named in the row; listed as allowed output.

Q4.note: The 16 area names are not fixed in the row; contact-*.png matches the 16 sheets without naming them.

Q5.note: Same as Q4: 16 files, names not fixed.

Q6.note: Same as Q4: 16 files, names not fixed.

Z1.note: Owns are set per ticket; the ticket writes its own entry before the stray check.

Z2.note: 'Constants named in the code contract' do not name a file; no file is listed for them.

Z3.note: Amends Q9's file, so it is not a second owner.

open_gaps: monsters-bosses-tools.md 7.2 API changes to scripts/combat/hitbox.gd, scripts/enemies/enemy_base.gd, scripts/enemies/enemy_projectile.gd and scripts/core/layers.gd have no WP owner; the document needs an owner before wave 1 starts.

monsters-bosses-tools.md 7.3 puts minibosses and bosses in scripts/enemies/<name>.gd and tests/test_<name>.gd; the WP rows use scripts/enemies/minibosses/, scripts/enemies/bosses/ and tests/test_boss_<name>.gd. The manifest follows the WP rows.

G1 ward pockets are in the committed docs/world-graph.json (cave_10_10#ward, cave_6_8#ward, ow_8_5#ward, ow_9_1#ward) but no batch row lists them, so --global fails. Proposed rows: ow_9_1 +#ward in R3.a, ow_8_5 +#ward in R5.a, cave_6_8 +#ward in C06.b, cave_10_10 +#ward in C10.c; the lead adds them to docs/world-work-packages.md and runs --regen.
